description: Aerospace mission-control palette for the Streamlit dashboard. Base direction (NASA cyan on charcoal) is fixed by the PRD; everything else is derived to stay legible and disciplined around that one accent.

status.note: Maps 1:1 to simulation/states.json health_states (NOMINAL, DEGRADED, EMERGENCY, ABORT) so a single status color travels from the physics layer straight to the dashboard.

data_series.note: series_4 is intentionally muted — used for 'rule-based baseline' comparison lines so the Pareto/endurance improvement reads visually without competing with the primary result.

usage_notes: Never place accent.primary text on background.panel below 4.5:1 contrast for body copy; use it for numerals, icons, and chart lines, not paragraph text.

status.nominal intentionally equals accent.primary — nominal is the 'unremarkable' state and should not visually compete with the brand accent; degraded/emergency are the colors that should draw the eye.
